senses.en_definition: A girl or young woman, traditionally one who is unmarried.
Virgin; having never had sexual intercourse, in traditional or specific contexts.

collocations.en: still unmarried; still a virgin (depending on context)

senses.en_definition: (Indonesian, of an animal) Having never given birth or laid eggs.

collocations.en: a hen that has not yet laid eggs
a mare that has never foaled

messages.en: Who's that girl holding the camera? I feel like I've seen her before.
That's my younger sister! She used to come along to practice with me all the time, remember?

senses.en_definition: To fail to achieve a goal, accomplish something, or succeed; to fail an examination.

messages.en: I failed my driving test earlier. I hit a cone while I was trying to park.
It's okay, we'll practice some more. Now you know what you need to work on.
Has this month's pay come in yet?
Yes, I just checked my banking app. I'm going to pay the rent first.

senses.en_definition: A picture or visual representation, such as a drawing; an image.
A photograph; an image captured with a camera.

messages.en: That photo of us from earlier looks so good! But the one you sent looks a bit pixelated when I zoom in.
Want me to send the original as a document? The one I sent earlier got compressed.
Yes! Send it over and I'll save it later.
